evals.js: const s = moire.light.spot(); const pts = []; for (let k = 0; k < 24; k++) { const a = 2 * Math.PI * k / 24, r = s.r * (0.25 + 0.5 * (k % 3) / 2); pts.push([s.x + r * Math.cos(a), s.y + r * Math.sin(a)]); } await moire.predators.place(pts); moire.camera.set(3, s.x, s.y); return JSON.stringify(s)
